evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge — a directive performed with forceful, negative-valence insistence.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Imperative 'Remove all knowledge' with exhaustive enumeration signals urgent, high-arousal erasure — negative valence in the forceful demand to eliminate.
Flat declarative denial delivered without intensifiers or urgency — low-arousal, negative-valence negation settling a fact with finality.
